description: Instructions written as text (source code) that Python runs from top to bottom.
Text after `#` up to the end of the line. Python ignores it; it is a note for people.
`main.py` holds the functions the tests check; `demo.py` is the script the Run button executes.
`return` hands a value back to the caller; `print` only shows it on the screen. Tests check returned values.
The report Python prints when an error stops the program. Its last line names the error and what happened.
